title: Gassenpfoten
subtitle: The Cats of Tübingen
menu.title: What does {name} get?
zone.head: head
cat.mina.quirk: Sociable and curious. Knows everyone on the Marktplatz.
cat.brezel.quirk: Likes to warm up at the bakery's vent. A little shy.
cat.professor.quirk: Old and dignified. Only lets patient people come close.
toast.controls: WASD/arrows or click: walk · E: feed/pet a cat, talk to people · Shift: sneak · J: cat journal · T: fast-forward time
toast.controls.touch: Tap to walk and tap a cat. Use 🐾 to sneak up quietly.
toast.newCat: New cat spotted: {name}! It's in your cat journal now.
toast.stepBack: Step back a few paces so {name} dares to come to the bowl.
toast.disliked: {name} sniffs and turns away. Not a {item} fan.
toast.fled: {name} got scared and ran off. Approach more slowly (🐾 sneak).
toast.noTreat: No {item} left. Frau Häberle brings more tomorrow morning.
toast.refill: Frau Häberle left some treats on your doorstep. 🧺
toast.petLeft: {name} has had enough and walks away.
toast.content: {name} is content and just wants to doze now.
pet.hint: Press and hold to pet {name}. Watch the body language!
journal.title: 📖 Cat journal
quest.first-friend.title: First friendship
quest.first-friend.find: Find a cat on the Marktplatz.
quest.first-friend.feed: Feed a cat. Put the bowl down and step back.
quest.first-friend.pet: Pet a cat you have fed.
quest.gourmet.title: Gourmet
quest.night-owl.title: The night owl
quest.night-owl.find: People talk about an old cat that sits by the Rathaus arcades in the evening.
toast.locked: {place} is still closed. Get to know the cats here first – maybe someone will know a way in soon.
toast.unlocked: New place: {place}! Follow the arrow at the edge.
cat.hoelderlin.quirk: Sits for hours, gazing melancholically at the Neckar.
cat.kahn.quirk: Practically lives on the punts. Sometimes rides along.
quest.river-cats.title: River cats
quest.river-cats.go: Take the southern alley down to the Neckarfront.
quest.river-cats.poet: They say a grey cat sits by the Hölderlinturm, gazing thoughtfully at the water.
quest.river-cats.boat: Feed the cat that lives on the punts.
toast.weather.rain: It starts to rain. The cats look for somewhere dry. 🌧️
toast.weather.fog: Fog rises from the Neckar. You can barely see your hand … 🌫️
cat.lotte.quirk: Three colours and proud of it. When it rains she sits under the arcades and watches the market.
cat.schatten.quirk: All black and very shy. They say she only comes down to the river with the morning fog.
cat.socke.quirk: Grey with white socks. Greets everyone who crosses the bridge.
toast.bande: {name} hisses quietly. The Rote Bande is no joke.
toast.newBande: That's {name} of the Rote Bande. Watch your food!
toast.bandeComing: {name} has smelled the food and comes running!
toast.bandeStole: {thief} stole {name}'s food! Distract the gang first next time.
toast.distracted: {name} pounces on the ball of yarn. That'll keep him busy for a while!
cat.baron.quirk: Huge, orange and full of himself. The boss of the Rote Bande likes your food best.
cat.ruebe.quirk: Baron von Möhre's right paw. Hangs around the Neckar and steals anything that isn't nailed down.
npc.haeberle.greet.0: Grüß Gott! How lovely that you look after the cats.
npc.haeberle.greet.1: Oh, it's you again! Come here, I've got something for you.
npc.haeberle.greet.2: My Brezel was already here this morning. That cat eats me out of house and home.
npc.haeberle.bande: And watch out for the Rote Bande! Baron von Möhre steals every little cat's food. Take these balls of yarn – they keep the rascal busy.
npc.jonas.greet.0: So? Searching for meaning too? Or just for cats?
npc.jonas.greet.1: Hölderlin lived here, you know. That grey cat probably knew him.
npc.jonas.greet.2: I'm writing my thesis. For seven semesters now. Going great.
npc.jonas.schatten: There's an all-black cat around here. Schatten. She only comes when there's morning fog on the Neckar. And she loves catnip.
npc.giftFull: Your bag is full – {item} another time.
npc.hint.where: {name}? You'll often find her here: {spot} ({place}). Best time: {phase}.
npc.hint.only: {name} only shows up in {weather} ({place}). Otherwise she's vanished into thin air.
npc.hint.likes: Do you know what {name} likes best? {item}!
npc.forecast.fog: Smell that? Fog is coming to the Neckar soon. That's when the shadows come out.
quest.meet-haeberle.title: The cat lady
quest.meet-haeberle.talk: Talk to Frau Häberle by the bakery.
quest.bande-trouble.title: Trouble with the Rote Bande
quest.bande-trouble.spot: They say a big red tomcat is terrorising the Marktplatz. Keep an eye out.
quest.bande-trouble.distract: Distract a member of the Rote Bande with a ball of yarn.
quest.fog-cat.title: The fog cat
quest.fog-cat.ask: Ask Jonas at the Neckarmauer about night cats (afternoon to night).
quest.fog-cat.find: Wait for morning fog on the Neckar and find Schatten.
quest.fog-cat.feed: Feed Schatten. She is very shy – sneak up on her.
cat.puschi.quirk: A fluffy cloud with eyes. Never goes anywhere without Fetzi – nobody knows who's looking after whom.
cat.fetzi.quirk: Scruffy, quick and always one leap ahead of Puschi. Where Fetzi is, Puschi isn't far. And the other way round.
cat.kuerbis.quirk: The youngest member of the Rote Bande. Holds the brain cell least often of them all. It shows.
npc.haeberle.greet.3: The red ones? They share one brain cell, gell. I can always tell who's got it – that one looks ever so important.
npc.haeberle.greet.4: The Herr Oberbürgermeister has been by three times today. He measured my shopping basket. Because of some by-law.
npc.jonas.greet.3: If all orange cats share one brain cell – is Rübe thinking? Or is the cell currently thinking Rübe? I'm starting my thesis over again.
npc.jonas.greet.4: I've never seen Puschi and Fetzi apart. I think it's one cat that spreads itself over two bodies for organisational reasons.
npc.palmer.greet.0: Palmer, mayor. Do you have an appointment? No? Excellent. Appointments are overrated.
npc.palmer.greet.1: Ah, you again! You're on the Marktplatz more often than my town council.
npc.palmer.greet.2: I'm on an inspection round. I'm inspecting … er … the overall situation. It's good. For cats, at least.
npc.palmer.greet.3: Psst! I'm hiding from a meeting about whether we need a meeting. You didn't see me.
npc.palmer.greet.4: Do you know what's lovely about cats? They don't fill in forms. They just sit on them.
npc.palmer.intro: I need your help. Completely unbureaucratically. The orange cats sometimes just stop – as if frozen. My theory: they share a single brain cell. Take a close look at one of those frozen cats. And if you see the cell hop across: report to me. Verbally! No forms.
npc.palmer.report: You saw it? A brain cell hopping from cat to cat? I knew it! I'll write to the state government at once. No, wait … then they'll set up a commission. We keep this to ourselves. Here, for your trouble – no receipt required.
npc.palmer.bark.0: I did the maths: this fountain would need eleven permits today. Neptune didn't have a single one.
npc.palmer.bark.1: An application for permission to submit an application. In triplicate. Who comes up with this?!
npc.palmer.bark.2: That cat has no residents' parking permit. And it's lying there anyway. Now that's pragmatism!
npc.palmer.bark.3: Is that a disposable cup? 50 cents packaging tax. Applies to cats too. Especially orange ones.
npc.palmer.bark.4: The orange cats share one brain cell. I've applied to the state for a second one. Processing time: 14 months.
npc.palmer.bark.5: *counting cobblestones* … 4711, 4712 … where was I? Never mind. Either way, too many regulations per stone.
npc.palmer.bark.6: Yesterday the Baron sat on my bicycle saddle. I served him an official notice. He slept on it.
npc.palmer.bark.7: Form K-17: reporting a stray cat. Form K-18: reporting that Form K-17 has been lost.
npc.palmer.bark.8: I timed how long Kürbis stares at a wall. 47 seconds. Faster than any building permit.
npc.palmer.bark.9: A data protection impact assessment for a cat photo? Ha noi!
npc.palmer.bark.10: A scratching post in a public space needs a special-use permit. I didn't know that either. Now I do. Sadly.
npc.palmer.bark.11: *measures a sleeping cat with a folding ruler* … 42 centimetres. That's a parking space. That means fees. Oh, let's not.
npc.palmer.bark.12: If I got a cat for every binder of paperwork, the Marktplatz would be full. Hm. Not a bad idea, actually.
npc.palmer.bark.13: I invited the Rote Bande to a town hall meeting. Only Kürbis came. And he stared at the wall the whole time.
quest.one-brain-cell.title: The one brain cell
quest.one-brain-cell.meet: The mayor, Boris Palmer, roams the Marktplatz grumbling about red tape. Talk to him.
quest.one-brain-cell.observe: Find an orange cat that has frozen mid-thought and take a close look at it.
quest.one-brain-cell.hop: Watch the brain cell hop from one orange cat to another. Where there are two orange ones, it happens sooner or later.
quest.palmer-report.title: Verbal report
quest.palmer-report.report: Report back to Boris Palmer. Verbally – no forms!
toast.buffering.0: {name} stares into the void. The brain cell is currently with: {holder}.
toast.buffering.2: {name} has forgotten what he was about to do. And why. And possibly who he is.
toast.buffering.3: {name} doesn't react. Orange cats share one brain cell – and right now it's with: {holder}.
toast.braincell.first: Did you see that? Something small and pink just hopped from {from} to {to}. The brain cell!
toast.braincell.thief: {name} stops dead mid-run. The brain cell has left the building. Now's your chance!
toast.braincell.outage: Every orange cat freezes at once. The brain cell has apparently gone on a day trip to Reutlingen.
toast.bestFriend: {name} won't leave your side and now follows you everywhere – just like a dog! 🐾 (Pet him and press E again to let him stay)
cat.bello.quirk: A huge Maine Coon who thinks he's a dog. Wags his tail, loves belly rubs and follows his favourite human everywhere.
npc.palmer.bark.14: That tomcat follows you around like a dog. Do I have to charge dog tax now? I'll ask the treasurer. No. Better not.
shop.title: {name} – you have 🪙 {coins} Taler
toast.bagFull: No more {item} fits in your bag.
toast.demo.start: 📢 A demo is marching across the Marktplatz! The cats are running for it.
toast.demo.end: The demo has moved on. Slowly the cats dare to come back.
cat.nepeta.quirk: Lilac-grey with glassy green eyes. Trembles, sniffs every flower pot and thinks of one thing only: catnip.
cat.rasta.quirk: Shaggy, smoky grey and deeply relaxed. Likes to lie in Günni's shady corner and blink in slow motion.
cat.dusel.quirk: Sleeps standing, sitting and while eating. Only wakes up when there's a whiff of catnip – but then properly.
cat.zappel.quirk: A nervous bundle of blue-grey. After a dose of catnip he chases butterflies that aren't there for minutes on end.
npc.palmer.greet.5: I've skipped three meetings today already. I call it being close to the people.
npc.palmer.greet.6: If you see anyone selling catnip: I don't want to know. Well. Actually I do.
npc.palmer.greet.7: Do you know why I like the Marktplatz so much? No Wi-Fi for video conferences.
npc.palmer.greet.8: Grüß Gott! You look like someone who gets things done. That's rare in this town.
npc.palmer.giftCoins: And here: {amount} Taler. An allowance for cat-watching. Tax-free, I think.
npc.palmer.bark.15: The Bota has opening hours. The cats there have different ones. So does the gentleman in the hoodie.
npc.palmer.bark.16: Schlager, Schlager, Schlager. I can hear Mr Kuhn all the way into my meetings.
npc.palmer.bark.17: A demo without registration is an administrative offence. A demo with registration is … also exhausting.
npc.palmer.bark.18: I applied to have catnip added to the narcotics act. Berlin replied: “Ha noi.” They speak Swabian?!
npc.palmer.bark.19: Oat milk, cargo bikes, jute bags. I've got nothing against any of it. Only against forms.
npc.palmer.bark.20: If the cats run away from a demo – is that a counter-demo?
npc.palmer.catnip: Between you and me: there's a cat hanging around behind the Rathaus in the evenings. Lilac-grey, eyes like saucers. Nepeta, she's called. Trembles, sniffs every flower pot and wants only one thing: catnip. I smell a black market! Here, a sample from the evidence room. Find out where she gets the stuff.
npc.palmer.catnipWait: Well? Found Nepeta? Evenings and nights, in the alleys behind the Rathaus. And give her catnip, or she won't say a word. Well … won't miaow a word.
npc.palmer.catnipReport: She smelled of greenhouse? Warm and damp, like the Tropenhaus? Then the case is clear: the Botanical Garden. The Bota. There are … characters hanging around there at night. Here, the key to the side gate behind the Rathaus. Which I of course never gave you.
npc.palmer.kuhn: Noise complaint! From the Neckarfront. There's a man in a curly wig singing Schlager. For decades now. Go and tell him to keep it down a bit. I'd go myself, but then he'd sing for me. Last time that took three hours.
npc.palmer.kuhnWait: Have you been to Mr Kuhn yet? Neckarfront, by the Hölderlinturm, midday to evening. You'll hear him before you see him.
npc.palmer.kuhnReport: He's singing an octave lower now? And complained about another band for half an hour? Yes, he does that. Well done! Here, a small allowance. No form required.
npc.palmer.demo: I'm getting complaints. People keep marching across the Marktplatz demonstrating for vegan cats. The cats don't like it at all and run off. Is that demo even registered? Have a look next time they come through. It happens all the time during the day.
npc.palmer.demoWait: Haven't seen a demo yet? It'll come, trust me. During the day, here on the Marktplatz. You can hear them from far away.
npc.palmer.demoReport: Properly registered? With a plenary, consensus and an oat milk stand? Fine. Then I can't say anything. But the cats are allowed to run away. That's freedom of expression too. Thank you!
npc.guenni.greet.0: Psst. You. Yes, you. Need something … green? For the cats, obviously.
npc.guenni.greet.1: I'm not here. We've never met. What do you want?
npc.guenni.greet.2: Fresh stuff. From the Tropenhaus. Don't ask.
npc.guenni.greet.3: The cats here are regulars. They pay badly, but they always come back.
npc.guenni.greet.4: Catnip. Organic. Local. Fair trade. More or less.
npc.guenni.greet.5: No photos. No questions. No receipt. Taler, cash on the paw.
npc.guenni.intro: New around here, huh? Okay, the rules: I only sell catnip. Totally legal. I think. Three Taler a bag. Rasta, Dusel and Zappel are my best customers. Give them some and they'll like you. Don't … well.
npc.guenni.bark.2: This isn't a hoodie. It's camouflage.
npc.guenni.bark.3: The mayor was here again. I hid behind Rasta.
npc.guenni.bark.4: Holland? Nah. Tropenhaus. Row three, behind the banana plant.
npc.guenni.bark.5: Zappel, you've had two today already. Come back tomorrow.
npc.guenni.bark.6: I studied business once. Here in the bushes I finally get to use it.
npc.guenni.bark.7: Pay first, then sniff. Not the other way round, Dusel.
npc.kuhn.greet.0: Hello, sweetheart! Dieter Thomas Kuhn, Schlager king of the Neckarfront. Autograph? Free, just give me a smile.
npc.kuhn.greet.1: Do you know what Schlager is? Schlager is love in flared trousers.
npc.kuhn.greet.2: Others wear beards. I wear curls. And attitude.
npc.kuhn.greet.3: Rehearsal by the Neckar tonight. The ducks are my most honest audience.
npc.kuhn.greet.4: A frilly shirt is not a piece of clothing. It's a promise.
npc.kuhn.greet.5: Roy Bianco and the Abbrunzati Boys … don't say that name so loud, I'll break out in a rash.
npc.kuhn.complaint: A noise complaint? From Palmer? Ha! Tell him: Schlager isn't noise, Schlager is a feeling. But fine, from now on I'll sing an octave lower. You know who REALLY makes noise? Roy Bianco & Die Abbrunzati Boys! Retro Schlager in costume, with sunglasses and a stage name. Wonder where they got that from? From me! Just in Italian.
npc.kuhn.bark.0: ♪ Shalalala … ♪ That's not a lyric, that's a way of life.
npc.kuhn.bark.1: Roy Bianco. Bianco! I was wearing white suits while he was still practising the recorder.
npc.kuhn.bark.2: The Abbrunzati Boys do Italo-Schlager. I do Schlager. Notice something? They just glued Italy on!
npc.kuhn.bark.3: Curly wig, glitter, flares. There's only one concept like that. Or so I thought.
npc.kuhn.bark.4: I've got nothing against competition. I've got something against copies. With a mandolin.
npc.kuhn.bark.5: That cat has more rhythm than the entire Abbrunzati brass section.
npc.kuhn.bark.6: Schlager is like the Neckar: always flowing, and nobody quite knows what's in it.
npc.kuhn.bark.7: There used to be more tinsel. And more frills. Mostly more frills.
npc.kuhn.bark.8: When I hear “Roy Bianco” I get goosebumps. Not the good kind.
npc.kuhn.bark.9: A stage, a mic, a thousand people in flares. That's my work. You can't just move that to Italy!
npc.kuhn.bark.10: ♪ Ooh-ooh-oooh … ♪ The duck sang along. More talent than some boy bands.
npc.kuhn.bark.11: Anyone may sing Schlager. Just please not exactly like me.
npc.vegan-1.greet.0: Hi! Have you ever thought about what cats actually eat? Exactly.
npc.vegan-1.greet.1: We're here for the rights of all animals. Including tuna. ESPECIALLY tuna.
npc.vegan-1.greet.2: The plenary decided: today we're loud. Reaching consensus took four hours.
npc.vegan-1.bark.0: What do we want? Oat milk! When do we want it? NOW!
npc.vegan-1.bark.1: Tofu, not tuna! Tofu, not tuna!
npc.vegan-1.bark.3: Cats can be vegan too! … Why are they all running away?
npc.vegan-1.bark.4: We're here, we're loud, lentils make us proud!
npc.vegan-2.greet.0: I came on the cargo bike. That one over there, with the signs and the kombucha.
npc.vegan-2.greet.1: Meat is so 20th century. Like plastic bags. And cars. And fun, says my grandma.
npc.vegan-2.greet.2: There's a plenary about plenaries later. Coming?
npc.vegan-2.bark.2: Hey, that cat just hissed at my sign.
npc.vegan-2.bark.3: Lentils are just beans with ambition!
npc.vegan-3.greet.0: My sign has a heart on it. Painted with beetroot juice. All natural.
npc.vegan-3.greet.1: The cats don't get it yet. But we'll keep at it. With love. And a megaphone.
npc.vegan-3.greet.2: Got cat treats with you? Are they at least organic?
npc.vegan-3.bark.2: Two, four, six, eight – broccoli is really great!
npc.vegan-3.bark.3: We are peaceful – what are you? … Oh, cats. Okay.
npc.vegan-3.bark.4: Is the fountain fair trade, actually?
quest.catnip-trail.title: The catnip trail
quest.catnip-trail.ask: Boris Palmer has a job for you. Talk to him on the Marktplatz.
quest.catnip-trail.find: Find Nepeta. She hangs around the alleys behind the Rathaus in the evening and at night.
quest.catnip-trail.feed: Give Nepeta catnip. (Jonas at the Neckarmauer has more.)
quest.bota-deal.title: Green trade
quest.bota-deal.go: Go up the alley behind the Rathaus into the Bota.
quest.bota-deal.dealer: Talk to the guy in the hoodie in the shady corner behind the hedge (midday to night).
quest.bota-deal.dusel: Give Dusel catnip (midday to evening, by the pond or the beds).
quest.bota-deal.zappel: Give Zappel catnip (evening and night). He's very nervous – sneak up on him.
quest.palmer-kuhn.title: Noise complaint
quest.palmer-kuhn.ask: Boris Palmer has another job for you. Talk to him.
quest.palmer-kuhn.kuhn: Deliver the noise complaint to Dieter Thomas Kuhn. He sings at the Neckarfront (midday to evening).
quest.palmer-kuhn.report: Tell Boris Palmer how it went.
quest.palmer-demo.title: Registered or not?
quest.palmer-demo.ask: Boris Palmer wants a word. It's about the Marktplatz.
quest.palmer-demo.see: Wait on the Marktplatz for the next demo (during the day).
quest.palmer-demo.report: Tell Boris Palmer about the demo.
